entities.name: Rutstein
entities.description: Human peasant and traveling Kessig merchant, Old Rutstein on Innistrad and Honest Rutstein on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: Region of Innistrad where Rutstein travels.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane Rutstein entered through an Omenpath.

events.summary: Rutstein drives a carriage of wares around Kessig, protected by charms and wards.
events.quote: Old Rutstein drives a carriage full of his wares around Kessig

events.summary: Rutstein enters Thunder Junction through an Omenpath and becomes known as Honest Rutstein.
events.quote: There, he became known as Honest Rutstein.
